# imgix Provider

Manage Imgix sources through the Imgix Management API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "imgix" {
  # or export IMGIX_API_KEY
  api_key = var.imgix_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Imgix API key with the Sources permission. Falls back to the IMGIX_API_KEY environment variable.
